notes:
Lead origin: inbound self-serve (marketing signup). Small SaaS help-desk company building a lightweight chat + tool-calling layer to pull account data and run small automations. Early discovery, strong technical involvement from CTO (Ben Ortiz).

Current pain: streaming responses with function calls in JSON mode are occasionally producing unparseable payloads on the client. Symptoms observed: braces/arrays split across stream frames, trailing commas, and the client (custom fetch streamer) fails to buffer correctly. They see the raw stream as repeated events that each contain fragments, e.g. '{"tool_result": "{"' then '"status": "ok"}'}' across frames. Quote from CTO: "We get half-JSON — braces split across frames and our parser chokes. Looks like some frames end mid-object."

What they tried:
- switched content-type on client to application/json (no change)
- tested Redwood JS SDK (basic) — SDK returns well-formed JSON but lacks the exact function metadata they expect
- increased client buffer timeout — no effect when frame boundary splits a function call payload
- attempted to force non-streaming mode (single response) — works but they need streaming for latency-sensitive UI

Technical hypotheses (from SE triage):
- function schema has required fields mismatched vs returned payload (server attempts to close/emit function_call chunk mid-object when runtime decides to call function)
- streaming chunking is occurring at wire level; event boundaries are not the same as JSON object boundaries — client must assemble full JSON by concatenating chunks until valid JSON is produced
- their client parser assumes newline-delimited JSON and fails when payload arrives as SSE-like event stream with partial lines

Logs / artifacts referenced: request id rwd-ccf-1312 (seen in their logs), sample chunk from their capture: "data: {\"type\":\"function_call\", \"payload\":\"{\\\"action\\\":\\\"update_ticket\\\", ...} }\n\"" — indicates escaped JSON nested in streaming data.

Support ticket INF-3421 opened to capture server-side delivery timestamps and raw SSE frames. Action items agreed:
- Provide SE-debug token and a small instrumented endpoint that returns deterministic frames (Jordan)
- Canvas to add a tiny harness to reassemble chunks and log framing (Ben/eng)
- SE to review function schema: ensure property names/required flags align with returned object; suggest single-root wrapper when using streaming function calls
- Short-term workaround: run non-streaming / batch call for critical paths or return compact single JSON object via tool instead of streaming fragments

- 2026-03-12: Small pairing session scheduled (30m) to walk through sample schema and reproduce client parse logic
